name: textprops
algorithm: Test 65,536 scalars from six ranges stable since Unicode 5.0 for a Unicode property, reps passes: Alphabetic (variant alphabetic) or General_Category Lu (variant upper); the checksum counts each hit plus the pass's index (README.md).

skip.c: no Unicode property in C's std: iswalpha and iswupper follow the locale, not the UCD
skip.zig: no Unicode property in Zig's std: std.unicode has UTF-8 and UTF-16 only
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; the task has no other integer arithmetic

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries; the properties' correctness is std/std-text_propstables_test.go's (every scalar against the UCD files)

skip.rust: no General_Category in Rust's std: char::is_uppercase is the Uppercase property (Lu plus Other_Uppercase), another task
